newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota shares recover in active trade.
newsitem.headline: Toyota shares recover in active trade.

text.p: Shares in Toyota Motor Corp recovered on Wednesday, rising 50 yen by 0439 GMT to 3,230 yen.
Toyota shares were the 12th heaviest traded issue on the Tokyo exchange with a volume of 1.49 million shares.
Market sources said investors were buying blue-chip shares centred on Toyota in an attempt at bargain-hunting after Tuesday's sharp falls which sent the key Nikkei average to a 12-month low.
Toyota closed down at 3,180 on Tuesday.
"After all, the target of buying centres on internationally competitive blue-ship shares whose business conditions are well established," said a fund manager at a major life insurance company.
